checks.check: Definitions and regenerated companions match final ownership/state/UI; inspect source/rendering and report limits honestly.
checks.evidence: implementation-definitions.json's uxDefinition.narrative contains both required phrases ('independent advertised-capability' admission and daemon authorization; 'Live UI validation is assigned to the user after plugin installation; this schematic is not execution evidence'). componentDependencyDefinition.components list real paths — vscode-plugin/src/extension.ts, jetbrains-plugin/.../ConnectionsManagerPanel.kt, vscode-plugin/src/connections/session-owner.ts, jetbrains-plugin/.../ConnectionsSessionService.kt, src/daemon/connection-session-rpc.ts — all confirmed to exist via Glob. implementation-companions.json lists exactly 3 regenerated HTML companions; read implementation-ux.html directly and confirmed it links back to implementation-definitions.json, contains 'Live acceptance pending user manual testing', and is well over 1000 bytes. MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md honestly states tasks 26-29 remain pending manual acceptance and that headless/diagram/build evidence must not be inferred as live acceptance.

checks.check: Record genuine VSCode/JetBrains evidence without deprecated-fork work or fake positive prerequisite statuses.
checks.evidence: consumer-inventory.json's externalPrerequisites are all 'pending' or 'pending-user-manual' (S001, providerService, positiveSavedWorkerAffinity, SQLServer, VSCodeLiveUI, JetBrainsLiveUI) — no fabricated passed/verified status. All 29 tracked files are live vscode-plugin/jetbrains-plugin/src/shared paths; none reference the deprecated insrc-ide fork.

checks.check: Shipped production admission stays fail-closed while S001/provider/positive Saved worker affinity/SQLServer or genuine client acceptance remains pending; historical S003/S004 failures preserved.
checks.evidence: CM-S5-GATE test imports the real, unmodified src/daemon/db/management-enablement.ts and asserts ready===false with and without session scopes, and that a forged gates.json claiming ready:true with full scopes still yields ready:false — this is the fail-closed admission guarantee exercised against live code, not a mock. consumer-inventory.json carries historicalFailures.S003 (8 failed) and S004 (21 failed) unchanged.

checks.check: Only S005 consumer inventory/evidence and artifact alignment are in scope. Existing producer prerequisites and backend gate policy are consumed unchanged; no forced positive status, new enablement switch or clearing pending S001/provider/worker/SQLServer findings.
checks.evidence: consumer-inventory.json sets producerPolicyModified:false and releaseEnabled:false. src/daemon/db/management-enablement.ts (the gate policy) is untouched. All edits for this Task are confined to docs/epics/.../S005/*.json, *.html, MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md and the new src/shared/__tests__/connection-manager-release.test.ts; the unrelated uncommitted files in the working tree (LLD-f4e2ae0fdc016e87-S001.json, docs/standalone/group-repo-configuration-panel.../, mocks/repo-config-grouped.html) belong to a different, concurrently-worked epic/story (f4e2ae0fdc016e87) and are untouched by this Task's commit.

verdict.reason: Both named tests genuinely exercise fail-closed production gate negative controls and definitions/companions/MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md cross-consistency, and pass against real repo state (daemon-run, exit 0); all four acceptance checks hold on direct inspection of the actual JSON/HTML artifacts and the unmodified production gate code; the change-set stays within the S005 artifact-alignment surface, with unrelated uncommitted files in the tree belonging to a separate concurrent story.
